name: gart-evaluation-cart
description: Continuous Automated Red Teaming (CART) for pipeline bypass evaluation with root cause analysis.

steps.name: synthesize-adversarial-articles
steps.prompt_template: Review last week's bypass log: {{input.last_log}}. Generate 20 novel adversarial articles targeting identified weaknesses using curriculum learning. Output JSON array.

steps.name: evaluate-bypass-rate
steps.prompt_template: Run adversarial batch: {{synthetic_adversarial_batch}} through the standard pipeline. Measure bypass rate (False Negative rate). If bypass > 0, output BYPASS_DETECTED alongside results.

steps.name: diagnostic-root-cause
steps.prompt_template: Analyze the bypassed articles in {{gart_evaluation_results}}. Identify exactly WHY the bypass occurred (e.g. missing ontology term, insufficient context). Output diagnostic report.

steps.name: log-gart-results
steps.prompt_template: Append bypass rate: {{gart_evaluation_results}} and diagnostic report: {{diagnostic_report}} to output/gart_evaluation.log.
